patches.name: Twitch Enhancement
patches.description: Kizu Twitch enhancements: third-party emotes, danmaku chat, live ad blocking, appearance controls including a toggle to hide Stream Extensions, deleted-message display, privacy controls, native Video Stats and single-tap Reload Stream, PurpleTV-style landscape brightness/volume gestures with swipe-to-portrait collapse prevention, Hide Stories, Go Ad-Free hiding, and patched-app compatibility.
